Mosslume uses unmodified official agentscope-core and agentscope-extensions-model-openai binaries.
Integration code in localforest.ai is original Mosslume glue code. The SDK is used for its
OpenAIChatModel, DeepSeekFormatter, Msg, ToolSchema and typed model response path only.
No generic filesystem, terminal, MCP, memory service or telemetry tool is initialized.
Model data is sent only by the guarded DeepSeek transport, with bounded responses,
request cancellation, one attempt, daily accounting and validated game intents.
The exact artifacts and checksums are in mod/dependencies/agentscope-lock.json.
